content: Flattery is a counterfeit currency which only circulates through our vanity.
author: François de La Rochefoucauld
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Living in pretense takes an enormous amount of mental energy. When you constantly manage impressions to please others, you end up feeling like an imposter in your own skin.

In François de La Rochefoucauld's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Honesty with yourself can feel uncomfortable at first, but it is the only ground upon which a real life can be built. When you stop lying to yourself about your feelings, your energy is immediately freed up.
reflectionPrompt: What hidden motive, insecurity, or fear might be silently driving your recent reactions?
